name: Berserker ring (i)
description: +4% melee strength bonus, on top of the flat strength stat shown — the imbued version's bonus is easy to miss since it isn't broken out separately in the stats interface.

name: Brimstone ring
description: 50% chance to boost Magic accuracy and lower the target's Magic defence on a hit, alongside its listed stat bonuses.

name: Ultor ring
description: +8% melee damage passively; further boosted at low HP, similar in spirit to Dharok's set effect but always active.

name: Magus ring
description: +5% Magic damage passively (12.5% when a staff normally granting Magic damage is wielded), not shown anywhere in the equipment stats panel.

name: Phoenix necklace
description: At or below 20% HP, restores 30% of your max hitpoints and clears all queued damage from future hits before the heal triggers.

name: Salve amulet
description: +16.67% melee accuracy and damage against undead targets, matching the common 1/6 strength bonus used by the item's tooltip and wiki references.

name: Amulet of the Damned
description: Adds Barrows-set effects when worn with a full Barrows set: Dharok's — 25% chance to recoil 15% of damage taken; this can stack with Vengeance and recoil effects. Verac's — +7 Prayer bonus on top of the amulet's +3. Torag's — Defence is increased by 1% for every missing Hitpoint, stacking with temporary boosts. Guthan's — heals up to 10 Hitpoints above your base Hitpoints level. Karil's — 25% chance to hit twice with one attack; the second hit deals half the damage of the first. Ahrim's — Ahrim's staff auto-casts Ancient Magicks and gives a 25% chance for combat spells to deal 30% more damage.
